annotations.title: Ask a question about a YouTube video

description: Answers a question about a YouTube video using its transcript, citing the timestamp [mm:ss] where each point is made. Works for talks, lectures, tutorials, podcasts and webinars. If no question is given it returns the key takeaways.

question.description: What to find out from the video. Optional; defaults to the key takeaways.
